title: Hull Breach
summary: Debug a broken script: a missing library(), = vs ==, capitals and a missing na.rm.
hints: Fix the first problem R reports, then run again. `=` assigns; comparing needs `==`.
`read_csv()` lives in readr, which has to be loaded. Then compare the spellings with `unique(survey$group)` and `names(survey)`.
A column that doesn't exist gives `NULL` from `$` without an error. And three post-test scores are missing, so both means need `na.rm = TRUE`.
